newsitem.title: SPAIN: Bankinter 97 pre-tax profits to rise 10 pct. [CORRECTED 13:15 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Bankinter 97 pre-tax profits to rise 10 pct. [CORRECTED 13:15 GMT]

text.p: Bankinter managing director (Corrects from chairman) Juan Arena said on Tuesday that the bank's pre-tax profit could rise 10 percent in 1997 from 24.93 billion pesetas in 1996.
"In 1997 we will have two-digit growth of around 10 percent," Arena told journalists at a news conference.
Arena added that growth in this year's results would depend, among other factors, on developments in private consumption.
The year would be characterised by more growth in client activities than in treasury activities.
